description: Combine 2 to 10 PDFs into one document, in the order given. Use this to join separate scans, chapters or invoices into a single file. Password-protected files must be unlocked first.

files.description: Absolute paths to the PDFs, in the order they should appear.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: merge_pdfs
